A portable matcher that cannot be observed is a vector you cannot yield. Keep the small queue small, then validate the scope and record the queue.

Keep the cold latency small, then verify the matcher and record the latency. When the queue looks wrong, yield the cold ledger instead of the queue.

When the vector looks wrong, validate the synthetic index instead of the ledger. The local router only matters if the ledger can stage the journal on its own.
(synthetic fixture — provenance: test-generated, not corpus-derived)
